# Village Pediatric Dentistry

> A comprehensive pediatric dental practice in Cumming, GA specializing in age-appropriate dental care, orthodontics, and special needs dentistry for infants, children, and teens.

Village Pediatric Dentistry, led by board-certified orthodontist Dr. Susan Podray-Donovan, DMD, MS, offers preventive care, advanced dental technology including digital X-rays, and specialized services like Silver Diamine Fluoride treatment. The practice serves families throughout the Cumming area with a focus on early childhood oral health and creating positive first dental experiences.
